work.title: Capitec
work.description: In my role as a Software Engineer at Capitec, I'm at the forefront of developing financial applications using Vue.js, KendoUI, and Micro Frontend architecture. My work involves crafting responsive and intuitive user interfaces with HTML, JavaScript, and TypeScript, while seamlessly integrating with Java backend services. I contribute to the bank's digital transformation by implementing scalable solutions within a Micro Frontend ecosystem, enhancing the overall customer experience in online banking platforms. This position allows me to leverage my frontend expertise in a fintech environment, constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible in modern banking software.
